correctness.rationale: The pairmorph mapping is an anti-isomorphism, so the unit group is the equivariant permutation centralizer S_n x B_N; its C2^3 abelianization gives the lower bound for n>=3. Explicit signed-permutation generators u=(e1,cN), v=(0,tN) yield e2 via u^N(uv)^{N-1}, hence all flips; combining with adjacent transpositions yields the explicit three-generator full product. The diagonal restriction homomorphism partitions nonunits into two indispensable types, forcing at least five full-monoid generators. Boundary n=1,2 is handled. Full proof and exact finite checker paths provided. Exhaustive n=3 table multiplication corroborates, without replacing universal proof.

originality.rationale: The existing group-of-units decomposition and unit order are expressly treated as known. The 2026 generator-set article establishes a four-element lower bound on the full magma monoid and a two-generator proper unit subgroup, not the rank-three theorem for the entire unit group. value.rationale: The exact group-of-units generating rank is a natural and previously unstated invariant for a recent algebraic family; its stable value three and uniform explicit generators are structurally informative despite factorial/exponential group growth. The result improves the cited 2026 four-generator obstruction for the entire magma monoid to a rigorous five-generator lower bound for every n>=3, using independently necessary diagonal singularity types. It does not claim the full monoid has rank exactly five.
